The '''Dustig Pocket''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] southern quadrant that would eventually be classified as part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. This area emerged with the discovery of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] in [[8000 BBY]] and the establishment of the [[Dustig Trace]], a short but useful [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected Malastare to the [[Kath system/Legends|Kath]] and [[Demos system/Legends|Demos systems]]. The Dustig Pocket acted as a small enclave of civilization, as it was surrounded by a region that remained largely [[Wild Space/Legends|unexplored]] for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="TEA" />
